Title: Products used by Review | Product Hunt
## Review. ## Code review on your own machine, with optional AI. A desktop app for Git branches and GitHub pull requests. Comment on any line, publish when you're ready, and add an AI reviewer with your own model, or none. ## Products used by Review. ### Explore the tech stack and tools that power Review. See what products Review uses for development, design, marketing, analytics, and more. Electron FiddleCreate, run, package, and share experiments with Electron. Electron let me ship Review as a real desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux from one codebase, with access to Git, the file system and the system keychain. OllamaThe easiest way to run large language models locally. Ollama is how Review offers fully local AI code review. Pick a model, and your code never leaves your machine. Its OpenAI-compatible API made the integration straightforward. Claude by AnthropicA family of foundational AI models. Built much of Review with Claude Code: from the AI review runner to the retry and stop/resume flow. It handled the whole loop, from code and tests to PRs and the release, and kept the codebase consistent as it grew.
